notes:
Topline: Aegis is a mid-market CX platform that provides omnichannel ticketing for SMEs. Evaluating Redwood to replace homegrown summarization + tagging rules that break during spikes. Key ask: concise ticket + email summaries (one-line intent + 2-3 bullet action items) + deterministic auto-tags for workflows (product, billing, escalation, SLA-breach).

Context/asks: 
- POC requested: 2-week POC ingesting ~120k historical tickets (Zendesk export) + live integration to a staging Zendesk instance. 
- Latency target: suggested-summary generation <200ms (interactive agent bar) under typical load; fallbacks acceptable if >500ms. Peak throughput: sustain 600 reqs/min with <5% degradation during campaign spikes.
- Cost sensitivity: want cost per 1k summaries <= $1.50 (goal, negotiable).
- Labeling/auto-tagging: deterministic rules + model suggestions; need ability to override and persist macros back to Zendesk/Freshdesk via tool-calls/webhooks.
- Hallucination concern: "We need summaries that don't invent missing facts" — quote from CPO Maria Chen.
- Routing/fallback: must be able to route to distilled quantized variant in Dedicated for burst capacity (service-level fallback).
- Compliance: SSO (SAML), SOC2 attestation, audit logs for every macro/tool-call, KMS integration for keys, EU data residency for EU customers.

Technical notes (from SE session 2025-11-18):
- Current setup: rule-based regex tagging + keyword heuristics; high false-positive rate during marketing blasts.
- POC plan: run batch inference over historical tickets to evaluate precision/recall on tags, then enable streaming agent-assist bar in staging for live evaluation.
- Evaluation metrics requested: tag accuracy by intent, summary ROUGE-lite (agent acceptance rate), latency percentiles p50/p95/p99, cost per token/summary.
- Integration points: Zendesk macros API, Freshdesk webhooks, internal CRM update webhook, Snowflake staging table for ticket exports.

1) >85% auto-tag precision on top 10 enterprise intents after 2-week POC.
2) Agent acceptance rate for suggested summaries >= 80% in live staging.
3) Summaries must avoid hallucinations; any hallucination rate >2% triggers rollback to rule-based assist.
